title: Between the Mint Leaves  (Entre as Folhas de Hortelã)

segments.t: Na mesa ensolarada dentro do Quarto 9, {Tessa} coloca a metade superior do cartão de receita rasgado ao lado do livro verde de botânica aberto, enquanto {Evelyn} e {Arthur} se inclinam sobre as páginas com ervas prensadas. Vamos ouvir primeiro.
Look right between these two dry sprigs of garden mint and lemon balm.
There is a torn cream card tucked flat against the spine of the book!
Slide it beside the top half from the tin capsule, {Tessa}—do the edges match?
Every tiny paper fibre lines up like two halves of a broken teacup!
Read the baking instructions aloud so I can copy them cleanly, {Tessa}.
Fold whole berries gently into the almond batter and bake forty minutes until golden.
Wonderful! That sounds simple enough—why did you squint at the bottom line, {Tessa}?
Because one big raindrop hit the blue ink right on the secret warm glaze!
Let me look through my glasses: Brush warm cake with two spoons of... blue smudge!
Blue smudge is not an ingredient sold at the Saturday market, {Evelyn}!
Do not panic, boss; we know the cake base, so my kitchen will test three glazes!
Three test cakes on a Sunday afternoon? Now THAT is historical research I support!
Agora vamos repassar a conversa com calma, frase por frase.
Look right between these two dry sprigs of garden mint and lemon balm.
'Olhe bem no meio entre esses dois raminhos secos de hortelã e erva-cidreira.'
There is a torn cream card tucked flat against the spine of the book!
'Tem um cartão creme rasgado escondido de forma plana contra a lombada do livro!'
Slide it beside the top half from the tin capsule, {Tessa}—do the edges match?
'Deslize-o ao lado da metade de cima da cápsula de lata, Tessa — as bordas coincidem?'
Every tiny paper fibre lines up like two halves of a broken teacup!
'Cada minúscula fibra de papel se alinha como duas metades de uma xícara de chá quebrada!'
Read the baking instructions aloud so I can copy them cleanly, {Tessa}.
'Leia as instruções de cozimento em voz alta para que eu possa copiá-las de forma limpa, Tessa.'
Fold whole berries gently into the almond batter and bake forty minutes until golden.
'Incorpore frutas silvestres inteiras suavemente na massa de amêndoa e asse por quarenta minutos até dourar.'
Wonderful! That sounds simple enough—why did you squint at the bottom line, {Tessa}?
'Maravilhoso! Isso parece bem simples — por que você apertou os olhos na última linha, Tessa?'
Because one big raindrop hit the blue ink right on the secret warm glaze!
'Porque uma grande gota de chuva atingiu a tinta azul bem na cobertura morna secreta!'
Let me look through my glasses: Brush warm cake with two spoons of... blue smudge!
'Deixe-me olhar através dos meus óculos: Pincele o bolo quente com duas colheres de... borrão azul!'
Blue smudge is not an ingredient sold at the Saturday market, {Evelyn}!
'Borrão azul não é um ingrediente vendido no mercado de sábado, Evelyn!'
Do not panic, boss; we know the cake base, so my kitchen will test three glazes!
'Não entre em pânico, chefe; nós sabemos a base do bolo, então minha cozinha vai testar três coberturas!'
Three test cakes on a Sunday afternoon? Now THAT is historical research I support!
'Três bolos-teste em uma tarde de domingo? Agora ISSO é pesquisa histórica que eu apoio!'
Vamos ouvir toda a cena novamente em velocidade natural.
Look right between these two dry sprigs of garden mint and lemon balm.
There is a torn cream card tucked flat against the spine of the book!
Slide it beside the top half from the tin capsule, {Tessa}—do the edges match?
Every tiny paper fibre lines up like two halves of a broken teacup!
Read the baking instructions aloud so I can copy them cleanly, {Tessa}.
Fold whole berries gently into the almond batter and bake forty minutes until golden.
Wonderful! That sounds simple enough—why did you squint at the bottom line, {Tessa}?
Because one big raindrop hit the blue ink right on the secret warm glaze!
Let me look through my glasses: Brush warm cake with two spoons of... blue smudge!
Blue smudge is not an ingredient sold at the Saturday market, {Evelyn}!
Do not panic, boss; we know the cake base, so my kitchen will test three glazes!
Three test cakes on a Sunday afternoon? Now THAT is historical research I support!
O cartão rasgado se encaixa perfeitamente, deixando apenas uma cobertura secreta borrada de gota de chuva para a Tessa e o forno dela resolverem! Até a próxima.
See you soon!
